title: Replication package: Continuous structural complexity of history-based parametric CAD models and its association with parametric robustness
description: Metrics of 351 history-based parametric CAD models extracted with QualiCAD, perceived-complexity scores (S_MAP) for 106 models, Python analysis code and results (tables, figures, sensitivity analyses and the reference transformation that defines the Structural Complexity Index, ICE). Native CAD files are not included; model identifiers are listed instead.
